title: RecipeEvaluationInput
description: One candidate's evidence for the recipe compiler. Boolean genome ingredients arrive as eligibility-context.v1 signals whose signal_type is the ingredient id (e.g. tax.delinquent); numeric, date and category ingredients (equity.estimated_pct, tax_sale.sale_date, clock.*) arrive as measurements bound to the same evidence. A value in the wrong channel is refused. Ranking, projection and label fields (primary_recipe, rank, score, signal_tags, ...) are refused anywhere.

ingredient.description: A NUMBER / DATE / CATEGORY ingredient of the compiled set (canonical_recipes.INGREDIENTS).

value.description: NUMBER: finite number. DATE: ISO date. CATEGORY: state name (clock states are validated by the recipe).

basis.description: Refused when stronger than the ingredient allows (equity and valuation are at best ESTIMATED). A contradiction is decisive only when every contradicting measurement is VERIFIED.
